question: Which among the following options are the correct five layers of the **India AI Stack** that enable deployment and scaling of Artificial Intelligence applications?

options.text: Application Layer, AI Model Layer, Compute Layer, Data Centres Layer, Energy Layer
Application Layer, AI Model Layer, Compute and Machine Layer, Network Layer, Energy and Quantum Layer
Application Layer, AI Model Layer, Compute Layer, Data Centres and Network Infrastructure Layer, Energy Layer
Application Layer, Algorithm Layer, Compute Layer, Data Infrastructure Layer, Power Layer

solution:
The correct answer is __**Application Layer, AI Model Layer, Compute Layer, Data Centres and Network Infrastructure Layer, Energy Layer.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The India AI Stack is structured into five distinct layers that collectively enable development, deployment, and scaling of AI systems across sectors.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The India AI Stack consists of exactly five layers: Application Layer, AI Model Layer, Compute Layer, Data Centres and Network Infrastructure Layer, and Energy Layer.**
 
• These layers together provide the full ecosystem required for building, deploying, and scaling AI solutions.
 
• The Data Centres and Network Infrastructure Layer combines both storage and connectivity, making it a single integrated layer.
 
• The Energy Layer ensures reliable electricity supply, enabling continuous operation of compute systems and AI infrastructure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **AI Stack**__

 __
 
• An AI stack is the complete set of technologies required to develop, deploy, and operate AI applications.
 
• It integrates software, hardware, infrastructure, and energy systems.
 
• It ensures scalable, reliable, and population-scale deployment of AI.
 
 
 
• **Compute Layer**__
 __
 
• Provides computational power through GPUs, TPUs, and NPUs.
 
• Supports training and execution of AI models.
 
• Determines speed, efficiency, and scalability of AI systems.
 
 
 
• **Data Centres and Network Infrastructure Layer**__
 __
 
• Acts as the backbone of AI deployment.
 
• Stores AI data, models, and enables real-time connectivity.
 
• Includes broadband, cloud systems, and 5G networks.
 
 
 
• **Energy Layer**__
 
 
• Provides electricity required to operate AI infrastructure.
 
• Supports data centres, servers, and computing systems.
 
• Ensures sustainable and uninterrupted AI operations.
